entries.target: #GOLD#角色时装和自定义角色图像#WHITE#

entries.source:
Select the graphical mode to display the world.
Default is 'Modern'.
When you change it, make a new character or it may look strange.
entries.target:
选择显示游戏世界的图像模式。
默认是“现代”模式。
当你切换模式后，最好重新创建角色，不然图像可能看起来很奇怪。

entries.source:
Make the movement of creatures and projectiles 'smooth'. When set to 0 movement will be instantaneous.
The higher this value the slower the movements will appear.

Note: This does not affect the turn-based idea of the game. You can move again while your character is still moving, and it will correctly update and compute a new animation.
entries.target:
令生物和抛射物的移动更加平滑。设置为0时，移动看起来是瞬间完成的。
数值越高，画面显示的移动速度越慢。

注意：这并不会改变该游戏的回合制机制。
你可以在角色仍在移动时再次移动，游戏会正确更新并计算新的动画。
设置动画速度（越低越快）

entries.source:
Enables or disables 'twitch' movement.
When enabled creatures will do small bumps when moving and attacking.#WHITE#
entries.target:
开启或关闭“抖动”动画。
开启时，生物在移动和攻击的时候会“抖动”一下。#WHITE#

entries.source:
Enables smooth fog-of-war.
Disabling it will make the fog of war look 'blocky' but might gain a slight performance increase.#WHITE#
entries.target:
开启平滑战争迷雾。
关闭它会让雾看起来像是方块，同时让速度得到轻微的提升。#WHITE#

entries.source:
Select the interface look. Metal is the default one. Simple is basic but takes less screen space.
You must restart the game for the change to take effect.
entries.target:
界面样式，默认为金属，设置为简单可以节省屏幕空间。
改变设置后必须重启游戏才能看到效果。

entries.source:
Select the HUD look. 'Minimalist' is the default one.
#LIGHT_RED#This will take effect on next restart.
entries.target:
界面风格。默认界面风格“精简”。
#LIGHT_RED#重启游戏后生效。

entries.source: The number of lines to display in the combat log (for the Classic HUD).
entries.target: 战斗日志显示行数 (只用于经典HUD)。

entries.source: Draw faint lines to separate each grid, making visual positioning easier to see.#WHITE#
entries.target: 画出淡淡的线条分隔每个格子，让视觉定位更清晰。#WHITE#

entries.source:
Select the fonts look. Fantasy is the default one. Basic is simplified and smaller.
You must restart the game for the change to take effect.
entries.target:
选择字体样式。默认为Fantasy。Basic 为简化的小字体。
重启游戏后生效。

entries.source:
Select the fonts size.
You must restart the game for the change to take effect.
entries.target:
选择字体大小。
你必须重启游戏才能看到效果。

entries.source:
How many seconds before log and chat lines begin to fade away.
If set to 0 the logs will never fade away.
entries.target:
战斗和聊天日志开始消失之前的停留秒数。
设置为0则不会消失。

entries.source:
How long will flying text messages be visible on screen.
The range is 1 (very short) to 100 (10x slower) than the normal duration, which varies with each individual message.
entries.target:
更改角色上方闪过提示的停留时间。
1表示停留很短，100表示停留10倍时间，不同消息停留时间不同。

entries.source: Uses the icons for status effects instead of text.#WHITE#
entries.target: 采用图标而非文字来表示状态效果。#WHITE#

entries.source: Uses the icons hotkeys toolbar or the textual one.#WHITE#
entries.target: 采用图标快捷栏代替文字快捷栏。#WHITE#

entries.source: Number of rows to show in the icons hotkeys toolbar.#WHITE#
When you activate a hotkey, either by keyboard or click a visual feedback will appear over it in the hotkeys bar.#WHITE#
entries.target: 当你点击快捷栏或者使用快捷键时，将在快捷栏对应技能上有视觉反馈。#WHITE#

entries.source: When the player or an NPC uses a talent shows a quick popup with the talent's icon and name over its head.#WHITE#
entries.target: 当玩家或NPC使用技能时，会在其头顶弹出带有技能图标和名称的快捷提示。#WHITE#

entries.source: Size of the icons in the hotkeys toolbar.#WHITE#

If disabled lore popups will only appear the first time you see the lore on your profile.
If enabled it will appear the first time you see it with each character.#WHITE#
entries.target:
关闭后，手札提示只会在该手札首次出现在你的档案中时弹出。
开启后，每个角色首次看到该手札时都会弹出。#WHITE#

entries.source: If disabled items with activations will not be auto-added to your hotkeys, you will need to manually drag them from the inventory screen.#WHITE#
entries.target: 如果关闭，能使用的物品不会自动添加至快捷栏，你需要手动把它们从物品栏拖到快捷栏。#WHITE#

entries.source:
Toggles between various tactical information display:
- Combined healthbar and small tactical frame
- Combined healthbar and big tactical frame
- Only healthbar
- No tactical information at all

#{italic}#You can also change this directly ingame by pressing shift+T.#{normal}##WHITE#
entries.target:
切换战术信息显示模式：
- 生命值条+小框架
- 生命值条+大框架
- 只显示生命值条
- 不显示

#{italic}#在游戏中按Shift+T可以直接切换#{normal}##WHITE#
